headline.purpose: One per page: the page or Group name.

label.purpose: Buttons, field labels, legends, chips, metadata.

caption.purpose: Secondary conversions under an amount; avatar initials.

amount.purpose: Every monetary figure; tabular numerals, never truncated.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, sheets, the floating Add expense button, the skip link.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Colour transitions on buttons, chips and inputs.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action: Add expense, Save, Record settlement.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-accent, #2a62d6); color: var(--color-on-accent, #fff); font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-hover, #2156c9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-bg-primary, #f6f8fb), 0 0 0 5px var(--color-focus, #2a62d6); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions beside a primary one.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-input, #7d8799); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-text-primary, #131a26); font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-bg-tertiary, #e3e9f1); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-bg-primary, #f6f8fb), 0 0 0 5px var(--color-focus, #2a62d6); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Header controls: user menu, theme toggle.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-text-primary, #131a26); font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-bg-tertiary, #e3e9f1); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-bg-primary, #f6f8fb), 0 0 0 5px var(--color-focus, #2a62d6); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labelled control with hint and error wired through aria-describedby.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-text-primary, #131a26); } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-input, #7d8799); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-text-primary, #131a26); font: inherit; font-size: 16px; outline: none; transition: border-color 120ms; } .ds-input:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-focus, #2a62d6); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--color-error, #d32637); }

components.name: Member Chip
components.description: Selectable pill wrapping a hidden native checkbox or radio; used for Payer, participants and Split Type.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 4px 16px 4px 4px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-input, #7d8799); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-text-primary, #131a26); font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms, border-color 120ms; } .ds-chip input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; } .ds-chip:has(input:checked) { border-color: var(--color-accent, #2a62d6); background: var(--color-accent-subtle, #e7eefc); } .ds-chip:has(input:focus-visible) { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-focus, #2a62d6); } .ds-chip-avatar { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #0e7490; color: #fff; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Balance Status
components.description: A Balance as a pill: arrow icon, word and signed mono amount; never colour alone.
components.html: owes−$219.49gets back+$219.49settled up$0.00
components.css: .ds-balances { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-balance { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-balance-word { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-amount { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-balance-owes { background: var(--color-owe-subtle, #fce7ea); color: var(--color-owe, #b81f2f); } .ds-balance-owed { background: var(--color-owed-subtle, #dcf1e9); color: var(--color-owed, #08704b); } .ds-balance-settled { background: var(--color-bg-tertiary, #e3e9f1); color: var(--color-text-secondary, #566073); }

components.name: Ledger Panel
components.description: A bordered white list container with hairline-divided rows; no shadow.
components.css: .ds-ledger { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #dbe1ea); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-text-primary, #131a26); } .ds-ledger li { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 16px; } .ds-ledger li + li { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border-subtle, #e7ecf3); } .ds-ledger-amt { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Site Header
components.description: Header band with product name and ghost-button controls.
components.html: Expense Splitter
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 4px 16px; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--color-bg-secondary, #edf1f6); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border-subtle, #e7ecf3); font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-header-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-text-primary, #131a26); text-decoration: none; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-header-actions { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-header-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-text-primary, #131a26); font: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-header-btn:hover { background: var(--color-bg-tertiary, #e3e9f1); } .ds-header-btn:focus-visible, .ds-header-brand:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #2a62d6); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Every screen reads like a ledger that has just been reconciled: quiet, cool, exact, and finished. The interface is a precision instrument for money, so its identity lives in correctness made visible rather than in decoration. A single cobalt accent marks what can be acted on; a red and green pair, always doubled by sign, icon and words, marks who owes whom; everything else is cool blue-grey paper and hairline rules.

Density is moderate and calm. Content sits in one narrow reading column (672px) so a Group's Balances, Expenses and Settlements scan top to bottom like a statement. Type is a confident grotesque (Manrope) set heavy for headings and plain for prose, while every monetary figure switches to a tabular monospace (IBM Plex Mono) so columns of amounts align to the digit. Surfaces are flat, separated by borders and tonal steps; shadows appear only on things that float.

Light and dark themes are equal citizens: tokens swap, layouts do not. Dark is a cool graphite, not inverted grey. Motion is brief and functional, with one sanctioned moment of celebration when a Group is Settled Up and one deliberate piece of narrative motion when Simplify explains Debt Simplification.
keyCharacteristics: One cool-blue accent on cool blue-grey neutrals; no secondary brand colour.
Money in IBM Plex Mono with tabular numerals, never truncated.
Owing and being owed are never told apart by colour alone.
Flat surfaces with hairline borders; elevation reserved for floating layers.
Every interactive target is at least 44×44px.
Every text pairing meets WCAG AA in both themes.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the only brand hue. If something is not interactive or selected, it is not cobalt.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Owe and owed always carry a sign, an arrow icon, a word ("owes", "gets back") and a screen-reader sentence. A Balance stripped of its colour must still be unambiguous.

rules.name: The Red and Green Are Money Rule
rules.body: `owe` and `owed` describe Balances and nothing else. Errors use `error`; confirmations use `success`.

rules.name: The Figures in Mono Rule
rules.body: Every monetary amount uses the `amount` utility: IBM Plex Mono, tabular numerals, `white-space: nowrap`. Never truncate or ellipsize a figure.

rules.name: The Two Weights of Voice Rule
rules.body: Headings are 700 or 800; labels are 600; prose is 400. Weight 500 is reserved and almost never used.

rules.name: The 44 Pixel Floor Rule
rules.body: Every button, chip, link-button and toggle is at least 44×44px, on every breakpoint.

rules.name: The Only What Floats Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this sits above the page". Lists, panels and cards in the flow have a border and no shadow.

dos: Do use the `amount` utility (IBM Plex Mono, tabular numerals, no wrapping) for every monetary figure.
Do pair every owe/owed colour with a sign, an arrow icon, a word and a screen-reader sentence.
Do keep every interactive target at least 44×44px.
Do use `border-input` (≥ 3:1) for any control boundary; keep `border` and `border-subtle` for decoration.
Do style through the CSS variables in `tokens.css` so both themes follow automatically.
Do keep transitions on the motion tokens (120 / 200 / 360ms, `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)`), which collapse to 0ms under reduced motion. The one exception is the Simplify Animation.
Do keep reading content within the 42rem content column.
donts: Don't use `dark:` classes; theme switching swaps variables only.
Don't introduce a second brand hue or use cobalt for non-interactive decoration.
Don't use the `owe`/`owed` tokens for errors or success; charts use their own `chart-*` series tokens.
Don't put shadows on in-flow panels, lists or cards.
Don't map shadcn's `accent` to a hover background; `accent` is the brand cobalt and hover uses `bg-tertiary`.
